messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now survive snapshot export and loading.

Fixed pasted saves failing when JSON fields appear in a different order. Existing unnamed saves remain compatible.

Verified: 147 unit tests, 82 browser tests, type checking, and build passed. Changed files pass formatting; the full formatting check flags 53 unchanged files.
